data.gender_notes: Risl is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: It is a name derived from the Arabic word 'rashl' which means 'small rain'. It is a beautiful and unique name for a baby, evoking images of calmness and gentleness, just like a gentle rain. The name Risl carries the meaning “Small rain” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Risl usually hope their child will grow to embody small rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Risl represents the divine blessings of rain, symbolizing renewal, growth, and the nourishment of life.
data.etymology: Risl belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Small rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Risl total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ريسل
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريسل مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ر س ل' والذي يعني السرعة والخفة في الحركة، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية أن السرعة في الحركة تعبر عن الاستجابة السريعة لله تعالى، ومن ثم فالاسم يحمل دلالة روحية على السرعة في الاستجابة لله والامتثال لأوامره.

in_urdu.name: ریسل
in_urdu.meaning: ریسل کا مطلب ہے ہلکا اور تیز رفتار
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریسل نام عربی جذر 'ر س ل' سے ماخوذ ہے، جو تیز رفتار اور ہلکے پن کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں ایک مقبول انتخاب ہے کیونکہ یہ خوبیوں کو ظاہر کرتا ہے جیسے کہ تیز رفتاری اور چستی۔

in_hindi.name: रिस्ल
in_hindi.meaning: रिस्ल का अर्थ है तेज और हल्का
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिस्ल नाम अरबी मूल 'ر س ل' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है गति और हल्कापन। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक अच्छा विकल्प माना जाता है क्योंकि यह गति और चपलता जैसे गुणों को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: ریسل
in_pashto.meaning: ریسل معنی یې چټکتیا او روښانه
in_pashto.long_meaning: ریسل نوم د عربي ريښې 'ر س ل' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د چټکتیا او روښانتیا معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې د چټکتیا او ځواب ورکولو د ښه صفت لپاره کارول کېږي.

in_english.name: Risl
in_english.long_meaning: The name Risl is derived from the Arabic root 'ر س ل' (R-S-L), which signifies swiftness, quickness, or agility. This root is associated with connotations of rapid movement and responsiveness. In Islamic tradition, the name Risl may symbolize the individual's ability to act quickly and decisively, reflecting a proactive and dynamic personality. Historically, names derived from this root have been valued for their positive implications of speed and efficiency.

data.cultural_impact: The name Risl holds an inherently calming and soothing quality. Rain, in many cultures, is a symbol of renewal, rebirth, and refreshment. In Islamic context, rain is mentioned frequently in the Quran and is considered a blessing from Allah. Naming a child Risl may be seen as a reminder of this blessing and serene, calming effect that rain brings.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Risl holds spiritual significance in the way it represents renewal and possibilities. It reflects the idea that just as rain brings new life to parched lands, Allah refreshes our souls and minds, providing us with the spiritual nourishment we need. The name is a constant reminder of the blessings of Allah, and the hope for continued renewal in our spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun records the name Risl as a city in the Maghreb, possibly Tunisia, around 1375 AD, during his travels and research for his book 'The Muqaddimah'. The city was significant for its agricultural wealth and strategic location along the Mediterranean coast.

Al-Idrisi, a 12th century Muslim geographer, describes Risl as a city in present-day Morocco, with a notable fortress and a large agricultural hinterland. He mentions its importance as a center of commerce and administration under the Almohad dynasty.
